node.label: Bernard Bailyn
node.date_label: The Ideological Origins of the American Revolution (1967) · Voyagers to the West (1986) · Atlantic History: Concept and Contours (2005)
node.description: Historian of early America whose work connects political ideas, population movement and Atlantic processes. His presidential address treats early America as inseparable from European and African histories and argues for integrating specialized inquiries. Bailyn’s account of revolutionary ideas remains an interpretive intervention; neither institutional recognition nor later publication dates establish living status or sole authorship of Atlantic history.

proposed_edges.evidence_note: Own1981/1982 address opening; continental North America not a self-contained unit and process differs from a static Atlantic culture.
